```{r}
#all packages used
library(ggplot2)
library(haven)
library(dplyr)
library(ggsignif)
library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
#import data
dt <- read_dta("math.dta")
#summary(dt)

#original data the treat and female variable are numerical, 
#change them to factor in order for preparation for plot barplots.
dt<- mutate(dt, ftreat = factor(treat), ffemale = factor(female))
dt$Sex <- ifelse(dt$female==1, "Female", "Male")
```

```{r}
# create a function for summary analysis
data_summary <- function(data, varname, groupnames){
  require(plyr)
  summary_func <- function(x, col){
    c(mean = mean(x[[col]], na.rm=TRUE),
      sd = sd(x[[col]], na.rm=TRUE)/sqrt(length(x[[col]])))
  }
  data_sum<-ddply(data, groupnames, .fun=summary_func,
                  varname)
  data_sum <- rename(data_sum, c("mean" = varname))
 return(data_sum)
}
```

```{r}
#summary data to get sd
df_sum_math <- data_summary(dt, varname="correct_number_math", 
                    groupnames=c("Sex", "treat"))
# Convert dose to a factor variable
df_sum_math$treat=as.factor(df_sum_math$treat)
head(df_sum_math)
```

```{r}
#significance test
#between treatment and control
res.aov <- aov(correct_number_math ~ female * treat, data = dt)
summary(res.aov)
#within treatment group
dttreat <- filter(dt, treat == 1)
oneway.test(correct_number_math ~ Sex, data = dttreat, var.equal = FALSE)

dtut <- filter(dt, treat == 0)
oneway.test(correct_number_math ~ Sex, data = dtut, var.equal = FALSE)
```


```{r}
# comparison between treatment
p11<- ggplot(df_sum_math, aes(x=treat, y=correct_number_math, fill=Sex)) + 
  geom_bar(stat="identity", color="black", 
           position=position_dodge()) +
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin=correct_number_math-1.96*sd, ymax=correct_number_math+1.96*sd), width=.2,
                 position=position_dodge(.9)) +
  geom_signif(comparisons = list(c("0", "1")),y_position = 9.5,
    annotation = c("*")) +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())

#comparison within treatment
p12<- p11 
  # + geom_signif(
  #   y_position = c(9.5, 9.5),xmin = c(0.6, 1.6), xmax = c(1.4, 2.4),
  #   annotation = c("***", "***"), tip_length = 0
  # )
print(p12)
```

```{r}
# rename labels
p_math <- p12 +
  labs(title="Math Questions", x="Treatment", y = "Accuracy")+
   theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.title = element_blank())
ggsave("p_math.jpg")
```
